adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` does not persist anything (it just `render_serialized(@embedding, ...)`), and the only client-side "save" action added (`saveChanges()` in `admin-embedding.js.es6`) calls `this.get('embedding').update({})`. Also, the new `embedding.hbs` template contains only the hosts table and an `addHost` button—no control wired to `saveChanges`. This makes the PUT `/admin/customize/embedding` endpoint effectively a no-op/unused surface in this PR. It’s not a currently user-visible breakage because host persistence happens via `EmbeddableHost` CRUD (`host.save`, `destroyRecord`) rather than the embedding update route.
